blocks.text: Jab pani ke molecule ke atoms ke darmiyan covalent bonds toot-te hain to pani ionize ho kar hydrogen ions (H⁺) aur hydroxyl ions (OH⁻) bana deta hai. Aam halaat mein yeh reaction reversible (dono taraf chalne wala) hai aur equilibrium (tawazun) qaim rehta hai. Room temperature (25 °C) par ek litre pani mein har 550 million molecules mein se sirf ek ionize hota hai. Is liye khalis pani mein H⁺ aur OH⁻ dono ki concentration 10⁻⁷ moles/litre rehti hai.

Acids OH⁻ ions se mil jate hain aur H⁺ ions mahol mein bach jate hain, is liye mahol acidic ho jata hai. Isi tarah bases H⁺ ions se mil jate hain aur OH⁻ ions bach jate hain, is liye mahol basic ho jata hai.

H⁺ aur OH⁻ ions cells ke bohat se chemical reactions mein hissa lete hain, maslan macromolecules ki hydrolysis. H⁺ aur OH⁻ ki aapas ki miqdar (relative concentration) mahol ki acidity aur alkalinity, yani pH, tay karti hai. pH biochemical reactions par asar dalta hai; enzymes ek khaas pH par sab se acha kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Pani ka molecule (bara O aur do H) -> hydroxyl ion (O aur ek H; O par teer us electron ko dikhata hai jo O apne paas rakhta hai) + hydrogen ion (akela H). Labels: Water molecule H2O, Hydroxyl ion OH-, Hydrogen ion H+.
